en: Color postcard showing a city square with a bronze fountain sculpture of three muscular male figures working with hammers and anvil on a circular pedestal. Around the base are flower stalls and people walking on the cobblestone square. In the background stands a modern glass office building covered with company names in large letters, and an older ornate building on the right.
